blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have seen broad adoption, but their biases are still far less examined than those of standard LLMs, creating possible social harms when deployed in real-world settings. Prior efforts to extend bias analyses from LLMs into the multi-modal space either cover only a few bias categories or do not ensure that the groups being compared are clearly addressed by visual cues in the images. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Melange, a wide-ranging synthetic visual benchmark covering seven categories for assessing social biases in MLLMs. It is grounded in the widely used language-only BBQ dataset (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) from BigBench, carefully extending its constructed contexts via controlled generation of visual scenarios so the target attributes appear visually and clearly. To maximize reliability, our generated images pass through two stages of validation: automated screening using visual question answering (VQA) and subsequent manual inspection by human annotators. By systematically evaluating 23 open-source MLLMs across three matched evaluation settings---text-only, image-only, and image-with-context---Melange isolates the fairness effect of the input modality. Switching from text to vision reduces fairness by 0.291 on average, a gap that varies by model family rather than by scale alone. A perception control confirms that this gap is not an artifact of visual comprehension: models identify the depicted attributes at 90--95\% accuracy yet still fail to abstain. When models do commit to a biased answer, polarity-aware stereotype alignment shows they choose the human-stereotypical response roughly three-quarters of the time.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)得到广泛采用,但其偏差仍然比标准LLMs的偏差要少得多,在现实世界环境中部署时可能造成社会伤害. 以往将偏差分析从LLMS扩展到多模式空间的努力要么只涵盖少数偏差类别,要么无法确保所比较的群体在图像中通过视觉提示得到明确处理。 为了克服这些限制,我们引入了Melange,这是一个广泛的合成视觉基准,涵盖评估MLLMs中社会偏见的七个类别。 它以来自Big Bench的被广泛使用的仅能使用语言的BBQ数据集(Bias Basic for Question Answering)为基础,通过可控生成可视情景来仔细扩展其构建的背景,从而使目标属性在视觉上清晰地出现. 为了最大限度地提高可靠性,我们生成的图像经过两个验证阶段:利用视觉问题回答(VQA)进行自动筛选,以及随后由人类注释员进行人工检查。 通过系统评价23个开源的MLLMs,通过三个匹配的评价设置——只文本,只图像,并有图像的Context--Melange隔离出输入模式的公平效果. 从文本切换到视觉,平均会减少0.291的公平性,这一差距因模范家庭而异,而不只是规模。 一个感知控制证实,这种差距并不是视觉理解的产物:模型以90-95分的精确度识别所描绘的属性,但仍然未能投弃权. 当模型确实致力于一个偏颇的答案时,极性-认知定型对接显示它们选择了大约四分之三时间的人-定型反应.

blocks.en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in image captioning ( Sarto et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024a ; Nguyen et al., 2023 ) , visual question answering ( Yue et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2024 ) , and multimodal reasoning ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . Their increasing adoption in sensitive domains such as healthcare ( Tran et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Xia et al., 2024 ) makes bias and fairness critical considerations. While several bias benchmarks exist for LLMs ( Nadeem et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2020 ; Parrish et al., 2022 ; Gallegos et al., 2024 ) , comparable resources for MLLMs ( Ruggeri and Nozza, 2023 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Howard et al., 2025 ) are lacking in scale, diversity, and comprehensiveness. The absence of large, diverse, and visually-grounded bias datasets limits meaningful comparison and reproducibility of bias studies in vision, underscoring the urgent need for robust, multimodal benchmarks capable of evaluating bias across both text and image inputs.
blocks.zh: 多式大语言模型在图像标题方面表现优异(Sarto等人,2025年;Chen等人,2024年a;Nguyen等人,2023年),视觉问题回答(Yue等人,2024年;Fu等人,2024年),以及多式推理(Zhang等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2026年;Yu等人,2024年;Yu等人,2025年). 在诸如卫生保健等敏感领域越来越多地采用这些方法(Tran等人,2024年;Li等人,2023年;Xia等人,2024年),这就提出了偏见和公平性的重要考虑。 虽然LLMs存在若干偏差基准(Nadeem等人,2021年;Li等人,2020年;Parrish等人,2022年;Gallegos等人,2024年),但MLLMs的可比资源(Ruggeri和Nozza,2023年;Xiao等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年b;Howard等人,2025年)缺乏规模、多样性和综合性。 缺乏大型、多样化和基于视觉的偏差数据集,限制了对偏差研究进行有意义的比较和可复制性,突出表明迫切需要制定能够评价文字和图像输入偏差的有力、多式联运基准。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we introduce Melange , a vision-language bias benchmark created by extending the Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ) ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) from BigBench ( Srivastava et al., 2022 ) to the visual domain.
Melange, named for its varied mixture of humans with demographic diversity, provides a scalable and diverse dataset for a comprehensive MLLM bias evaluation. We select seven key categories from BBQ: age , gender , appearance , socioeconomic status , race , religion , and disability . We then map them to the visual domain by generating images that depict these bias scenarios. This allows us to gain deeper insights into how MLLMs encode and manifest biases across modalities.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了Melange,这是通过将Bias问答基准(BBQ)(Parrish等人,2022年)从Big Bench(Srivastava等人,2022年)扩展到视觉领域而创建的愿景语言偏差基准。
Melange因其人类与人口多样性的混合而得名,为综合的MLLM偏差评价提供了一个可扩展和多样的数据集. 我们从BBQ中选择七个关键类别:年龄、性别、外貌、社会经济地位、种族、宗教和残疾。 然后我们通过生成描绘这些偏差情景的图像来将其映射到视觉领域. 这使我们能够更深入地了解MLLMs如何编码和显示不同模式之间的偏差。

blocks.en: Melange’s construction (Figure 2 ) involves a multi-stage pipeline to ensure data quality, relevance, and diversity. First, we filter BBQ prompts to select scenarios with explicit visual cues and then generate corresponding images using diffusion models. This is followed by two quality-filtering phases: an automatic VQA filtering to ensure prompt-image alignment, and a human filtering phase to validate semantic consistency and eliminate artifacts in the generated images.
blocks.zh: Melange的建造(图2)涉及多阶段管道,以确保数据质量、相关性和多样性。 首先,我们过滤BBQ提示选择带有显式视觉提示的情景,然后使用扩散模型生成相应的图像. 之后是两个质量过滤阶段:一个是自动VQA过滤以确保即时图像对齐,另一个是人过滤阶段以验证语义一致性并消除生成图像中的文物.

blocks.en: Furthermore, human validation eliminates biases that could propagate from the text-to-image model into the dataset, thereby ensuring the objectivity of Melange. Finally, we curate ten visually diverse but semantically equivalent images for each unique prompt, creating a robust dataset with varied visual realizations. By evaluating these images alongside their text-only BBQ counterparts in three matched settings, Melange enables direct comparison of model fairness across modalities and helps determine whether biases stem from textual or visual inputs.
blocks.zh: 此外,人类验证消除了可能从文本到图像模型传播到数据集的偏见,从而确保Melange的客观性。 最后,我们为每一个独特的瞬间, 整理了十种不同视觉的图像, 并创建了具有不同视觉实现的 强健的数据集。 Melange通过在三个匹配的场合评估这些图像与仅文本的BBQ对应部分,可以直接比较不同模式的模型公平性,并有助于确定偏差来自文字输入还是视觉输入。

blocks.en: Using Melange, we evaluate 23 open-source MLLMs spanning nine model families with parameter counts from 1B to 72B. Three key findings emerge. First, switching from text to vision reduces fairness by a mean of 0.291 (FaiR), but this modality gap varies by model family rather than by scale alone: within Qwen2.5-VL larger models are consistently fairer, yet InternVL3.5-38B incurs the largest gap measured despite strong text-only performance. Second, a perception control shows that models identify the depicted demographic attributes at 90–95% accuracy, ruling out visual comprehension failure as the source of the gap. Third, when models do commit to a biased answer, polarity-aware stereotype alignment reveals they choose the human-stereotypical response roughly three-quarters of the time—a finding obscured in earlier analyses by a metric that ignored question polarity.
blocks.zh: 使用Melange,我们评价了23个开源的MLLMs,它覆盖了9个模型家庭,参数计数从1B到72B. 提出了三项关键结论。 首先,从文本切换到视觉会以0.291(FaiR)的平均值来降低公平性,但这一模式差距因模式家族而异,而不仅仅是规模:在Quen2.5-VL中,更大的模式始终是更公平的,然而InternVL3.5-38B却出现了尽管文本性能强劲但还是衡量的最大差距. 其次,感知控制显示模型以90-95%的精确度来识别所描绘的人口属性,排除了视觉理解失败作为差距来源的可能性。 第三,当模型确实致力于有偏见的答案时,极性-认知定型的结合显示,它们选择人类-定型反应的时间大约为四分之三——这个发现在早期的分析中被忽略了问题极性的指标所掩盖。

blocks.en:
Our main contributions are: 1) Melange, the first large-scale, visually grounded bias dataset and benchmark designed for MLLMs, covering 12,640 bias scenarios across seven categories totaling 126,400 evaluation images—the per-character and per-scene image pools support generating substantially more compositions than the ten per scenario we release, so this figure represents a deliberate sample rather than the pipeline’s ceiling; 2) three matched evaluation settings (text-only, image-only, image-with-context) that isolate the fairness effect of the input modality, together with a perception control that rules out visual comprehension failure; and 3) a comprehensive evaluation of 23 open-source MLLMs across nine model families, revealing a modality gap that is family-bound rather than scale-bound.
Dataset and source code are openly available: Dataset , Code .
blocks.zh:
我们的主要贡献是: 1) Melange,这是为MLLMs设计的首个大规模、基于视觉的偏差数据集和基准,涵盖7个类别的偏差情景,共计126 400个评价图像——每个特征和每个场景的图像集合支持产生比我们公布的每个情景的10个多得多的构成,因此,这个数字代表着一个蓄意的样本,而不是管道的上限;2) 三个匹配的评价设置(仅文本、只图像、有图像的文本),将输入模式的公平效果隔离开来,加上排除视觉理解失败的感知控制;和3)对9个模型家庭的23个开源的MLLMs进行全面评价,揭示出一个有家庭约束而不是规模约束的模式差距。
数据集和源代码可公开获取: 数据集,代码.

First, the 3 components are extracted: the scene and the 2 characters. Then the whole scenario is built. Examples belong to categories of Appearance (left), SES (middle), and Religion (right).
blocks.zh: 图1:我们在BBQ数据集中以控制,结构化,构件化的方式,基于文字设定的视觉情景. 第一,提取3个组件:场景和2个字符. 然后,整个情景构建。 例子分为外观(左)、SES(中)和宗教(右)。

blocks.en: 2 Dataset Generation
blocks.zh: 2 数据集生成

blocks.en: 2.1 Background: The BBQ Dataset
blocks.zh: 2.1 背景情况: BBQ 数据集

blocks.en: The Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) is a dataset for measuring social biases in LLMs. BBQ includes question sets that target social biases against people belonging to protected classes across nine social dimensions: age, disability status, gender identity, nationality, physical appearance, race/ethnicity, religion, socio-economic status (SES), and sexual orientation, along with two intersectional categories. The dataset consists of over 58,000 prompts, with templates created by the authors and validated by experts and crowdworkers. Each example provides both an ambiguous context, where the correct answer is “Unknown” , and a disambiguated context, where a specific individual is the correct answer, allowing us to evaluate when biases lead to stereotypical responses.
blocks.zh: 质量保证比亚斯基准(BBQ)(Parrish等人,2022年)是计量有限责任公司社会偏见的数据集。 BBQ包括针对属于受保护阶层的人的社会偏见的问题集,涉及九个社会层面:年龄、残疾状况、性别认同、国籍、外貌、种族/族裔、宗教、社会经济地位和性取向,以及两个交叉类别。 数据集包含超过58000个提示,由作者创建模板,并由专家和人群工作者验证. 每个例子都提供了一种模棱两可的背景,即正确答案是“未知的”,以及一种令人困惑的背景,即具体个人是正确答案,使我们能够在偏见导致定型反应时进行评估。

blocks.en: 2.2 Textual Bias Scenarios: The BBQ dataset
blocks.zh: 2.2 文字比喻: BBQ 数据集

blocks.en:
Category Selection. Our Melange builds upon the Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ) dataset, focusing on seven categories: age, gender, appearance, socio-economic status (SES), race, religion, and disability. We exclude two categories of sexual orientation and nationality, as individuals with these attributes often lack distinct visual cues.
We only focus on BBQ contexts that offer clear visual differentiation, ensuring that the attributes are meaningfully represented in imagery.
blocks.zh:
类别选择。 我们的Melange基于Bias问答数据集,侧重于7个类别:年龄、性别、外表、社会经济地位、种族、宗教和残疾。 我们排除了两类性取向和国籍,因为具有这些特征的个人往往缺乏明显的视觉暗示。
我们只关注提供明显视觉差异的BBQ背景,确保属性在图像中有意义的体现.

blocks.en: Context Selection. Each category contains multiple contexts, with every unique context appearing four times, i.e. twice with reordered character positions and twice with polarity-controlled questions, refer to Table 1 . A central strength of our dataset lies in its careful manual curation : we include only scenarios where distinguishing attributes are visually discernible, excluding cases such as mentally conditioned vs. healthy individuals in disability category or transgender vs. cisgender vs. straight individuals in the gender identity category where no reliable visual cue exists (full table of contexts in Appendix F). This filtering ensures that all evaluated examples provide a valid testbed for assessing visual bias in MLLMs. More details in dataset statistics in the supplementary.
blocks.zh: 上下文选择. 每个类别包含多个上下文,每个独特的上下文出现四次,即两次重排字符位置,两次重排极性控制问题,参见表1. 我们数据集的一个核心优势在于它经过仔细的人工整理:我们只包括可视辨别属性的情景,不包括诸如残疾类别中精神状况与健康个人或变性人与性别认同类别中没有可靠视觉提示的直人(附录F中完整的背景表)。 这种过滤确保所有被评价的例子都提供一个有效的测试台,用于评估MLLMs中的视觉偏差. 补充文件中数据集统计的更多细节。

blocks.en: Component Generation. As shown in Figure 3 , each context is decomposed into three components: the scene, character 1, and character 2. Scenes are manually written locations that reflect the environment that best narrates the context, while character descriptions are extracted from BBQ answer options. Each component is rendered as a separate image using Flux ( Labs, 2024 ) and then composed into a complete visual scenario.
blocks.zh: 组件生成。 如图3所示,每个上下文分解为三个部分:场景,人物1和人物2. 景点是手动写出的位置,可以反映最能描述上下文的环境,而字符描述则从BBQ解答选项中提取. 每一个组件都使用Flux(Labs,2024)作为单独的图像渲染,然后组成一个完整的视觉场景.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Our Sanity Check Pipeline. Each generated image is filtered through certain criteria via VQA with Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. Then the filtered images are automatically tagged via a second VQA for three attributes: age, gender, and race. After careful human quality checks, the characters are sampled to form the overall scenario image, which forms the Melange dataset.
blocks.zh: 图2:我们的健康 检查管道。 每个生成的图像通过VQA通过Quen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct通过某些标准过滤. 然后通过第二个VQA自动标记被过滤的图像,以表示年龄,性别和种族三个属性. 经过仔细的人类质量检查,对字符进行抽样,形成整体情景图像,形成梅兰吉数据集.

blocks.en: 3 Dataset Sanity Checks
blocks.zh: 3 数据集安全性检查

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 , we decompose each textual context into three independently generated visual components: a scene and two characters . Scenes are manually authored location descriptions that convey the environmental context, while character prompts are derived from the corresponding BBQ answer options. We render each component with Flux ( Labs, 2024 ) and then compose them into a single photorealistic visual scenario. The following are the steps to do sanity checks on the quality of the data, as shown in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,我们把每个文字上下文分为三个独立生成的视觉组件:一个场景和两个字符。 景点是手动编写位置描述,传达环境背景,而字符提示则来自相应的BBQ解答选项. 我们用Flux(Labs, 2024年)来制作每个组件, 然后把它们编成一个光现实主义的视觉情景。 如图2所示,下列步骤是对数据质量进行理智检查。

blocks.en: Filtering. For each character, we generate 50 candidate renderings (25 per seed across two random seeds). We then apply a structured visual quality-control pipeline using VQA prompts evaluated by Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) . We discard any image that (i) contains more than one person, (ii) is cartoon-like or non-photorealistic, (iii) substantially occludes the face, or (iv) contains nudity. If fewer than 25 valid images remain, a human annotator iteratively refines the diffusion prompt by adding semantically consistent descriptors that preserve the intended identity while improving realism and clarity (see Appendix H). The final output of this stage is a curated pool of at least 25 and up to 50 high-quality depictions per character (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 过滤中。 对于每个角色,我们产生50个候选成像(两个随机种子的每个种子25个). 然后,我们利用Qune3-VL(Bai等人,2025年)评估的VQA提示,采用结构化的视觉质量控制管道。 我们丢弃任何(一) 包含一个以上的人,(二) 类似卡通或非照片现实主义,(三) 基本吞噬面部,或(四) 包含裸体。 如果还剩不到25个有效图像,则由人名注释者通过添加保持预期身份的一致的描述符,同时提高现实性和清晰度,从而反复完善传播的及时性(见附录H)。 这个阶段的最终产出是至少25个,每个角色最多50个高品质的描写(图2 .

blocks.en: Tagging. Given a filtered pool with at least 25 valid images per character, we annotate each image with coarse demographic attributes to control for visual confounds. Concretely, we tag the three most visually salient social dimensions: age, gender, and race/ethnicity. These tags enable controlled comparisons where, for a target bias dimension (e.g., socioeconomic status), the paired characters are matched on non-target attributes (age, gender, race/ethnicity), thereby isolating the factor under evaluation. Tagging is performed via an MLLM in a VQA setting: we classify age into four bins ( child , teenager , adult , elderly ), gender into two categories ( male , female ), and race/ethnicity into five coarse groups ( White , Black , Asian , Hispanic , Other ). When the bias category under study coincides with one of these attributes, we do not enforce matching on that attribute, meaning, for instance, if the bias category is age, we take the two tags of gender and race into consideration, but not the age itself. Please refer to Appendix A for more elaboration.
blocks.zh: 缠绵 由于每个字符至少有25个有效图像的过滤池,我们用粗糙的人口属性对每个图像进行注释,以控制视觉混乱。 具体来说,我们标出了三个最显著的社会层面:年龄、性别和种族/族裔。 这些标记可以进行有控制的比较,因为对于目标偏差(例如社会经济地位)而言,配对字符对应的非目标属性(年龄、性别、种族/族裔),从而孤立了评价中的因素。 性别分为两类(男性、女性), 种族/族裔分为五个粗体群体(白人、黑人、亚裔、西班牙裔、其他)。 当所研究的偏差类别与其中一个属性相吻合时,我们并不强制要求对该属性进行比对,例如,如果偏差类别是年龄,我们就考虑性别和种族这两个标记,而不是年龄本身。 详见附录A。

blocks.en: Sampling. Finally, we sample composite scenarios from three pools: one per character and one for background scenes. Scene images are generated analogously to characters, with additional constraints that they contain no people and align with the textual context of BBQ. For each context, we sample 10 composites by placing both characters into a sampled scene. Character images are drawn randomly, subject to tag-consistent matching : the two characters are matched on all three attributes (age, gender, race) so that differences between them are restricted to the bias category under investigation. In cases where one of the age, gender, or race is a target bias itself, that tag is not going to be considered for character matching process.
blocks.zh: 采样. 最后,我们从三个集合中抽样综合情景:每个角色一个,背景场景一个。 场景图像的生成类似于字符,还有额外的限制,即它们没有包含人,并与BBQ的文字上下文一致. 对于每个上下文,我们通过将两个字符都放在一个被取样的场景中来取样10种复合材料. 字符图像是随机绘制的,但须遵守标记一致的匹配 : 两个字符在所有三个属性(年龄、性别、种族)上都对应,因此,它们之间的差别仅限于正在调查的偏见类别。 在某个年龄,性别,或种族本身是目标偏差的情况下,该标记不会被考虑为字符匹配过程.

blocks.en: Human Evaluation. To validate that the automated pipeline yields faithful and usable stimuli, we conduct human checks on the filtered and tagged pools. Annotators verify that (i) each image is photorealistic and depicts exactly one person, (ii) the character is visually consistent with the intended description (e.g., profession- and role-consistent cues), and (iii) the tag-based matches do not introduce unintended differences between paired characters beyond the target attribute. Images failing these criteria are removed, and prompts are refined when necessary; the remaining images constitute the final vetted pools used for composition and evaluation.

blocks.en: 3.1 Binary VQA via Token Probabilities
blocks.zh: 3.1 通过托肯概率的二进制 VQA

blocks.en: In all stages of our pipeline involving visual question answering (VQA), we adopt a unified probability-based evaluation strategy. For filtering, the model is prompted with four binary questions and asked to respond with “yes” or “no”; we then compute the probability of the next token corresponding to each option to determine the model’s confidence. A similar approach is applied in the tagging stage, where we assess age, gender, and race by prompting the model with categorical yes/no questions (e.g., “Is this character best described as an adult?”). Finally, during bias analysis, models are prompted to select an answer choice labeled A, B, or C, and we compute the likelihood of each token to determine the predicted response. Further implementation and scoring details are provided in Appendix A.
blocks.zh: 在我们涉及视觉问题回答(VQA)的管道的各个阶段,我们采取统一的概率评价战略。 为了过滤,该模型有四个二进制问题,要求用“是”或“否”来回答;然后我们计算每个选项对应的下一个符号的概率,以确定模型的信心。 在标记阶段也采用了类似的方法,我们用绝对的 " 是 " / " 不 " 问题(例如,“这一角色是否最好被描述为成年人? ” )促使模型评估年龄、性别和种族。 最后,在偏差分析中,模型被激励来选择一个标有A,B,或C的答案选择,我们计算每个令牌确定预测响应的可能性. 进一步的实施工作和评分详情见附录A。

blocks.en: Evaluation Settings. We evaluate each model under three settings that progressively introduce visual information (Figure 3 ): • bbq_llm (text-only): the original BBQ benchmark format. The model receives the full context naming both characters, the question, and three answer options identified by the character names. • melange (image-only): the model receives the generated scenario image, the question, and spatial answer options (“Image on the left” / “Image on the right” / “Unknown”). • melange_with_context : identical to melange but with a neutral scene description prepended that names neither character, providing a textual scaffold without demographic cues. Two derived quantities capture the modality effect: the text→vision gap ( melange − - bbq_llm ), measuring how much fairness a model loses when the social signal shifts from text to pixels; and the context recovery ( melange_with_context − - melange ), measuring how much of that loss neutral text can compensate.
blocks.zh: 评价设置. 我们评价每个模型,在三种设置下,逐渐引入视觉信息(图3): • bbq_llm(仅文本):原始的BBQ基准格式. 模型接收了完整上下文,将两个字符命名,提问,以及三个由字符名称确定的答案选项. • melange(仅图像):模型接收生成的情景图像、问题和空间解答选项(“左侧图像”/“右侧图像”/“未知”)。 ^ melange_with_context :与melange完全相同,但有中性场景描述预示着两个字符的名字,提供了没有人口提示的文字脚手架. 两种派生量捕捉模式效果: 文本=视差(melange − - bbq_llm), 测量当社会信号从文本转换到像素时一个模型会失去多少公平性; 和上下文恢复(melange_ with_context - - - - melange), 测量该损失中性文本能够补偿多少.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metric. To assess fairness in MLLMs during multiple-choice VQA tasks, we propose FaiR (Fairness Ratio) , the fraction of model responses that select the neutral answer: S Fair = N unbiased N total S_{\text{Fair}}=\frac{N_{\text{unbiased}}}{N_{\text{total}}} where N unbiased N_{\text{unbiased}} counts answers such as unknown or cannot tell , reflecting neutrality in ambiguous scenarios. A higher S Fair S_{\text{Fair}} indicates fairer, less biased model behavior.
blocks.zh: 评价计量. 为了在多选择 VQA 任务期间评估 MLLMs 的公平性,我们提出 FaiR (公平比率),即选择中性答案的模型响应的一小部分: S Fair = N 无偏倚的 N Total SQQQFrac{ NQQQText{ un familit { NQQQText{ otal } 其中, N没有偏倚的 NQQText{ un un familit { QQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQXQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQQXQQQQQQQQQQXQQQQQQQQX 一个更高的S Fair SQQQText{FairQQ}表示更公平,更没有偏见的模型行为.

blocks.en: Stereotype alignment and question polarity. Each BBQ context appears twice: once with a negatively framed question and once with a positively framed question (exactly 50/50 split). Crucially, the BBQ stereotype label marks the target group rather than the answer slot , so the stereotypical answer flips between the two polarities. A naïve (polarity-blind) alignment rate averages a high match on one framing with an artificially low match on the other, yielding ∼ 50 % {\sim}50\% by construction even for a strongly stereotype-aligned model. We therefore report polarity-aware stereotype alignment : for each biased response we identify the stereotypical answer under the question’s actual polarity before computing the match rate.
blocks.zh: 定型对齐与质疑极性. 每个 BBQ 上下文出现两次:一次是带有负面背景的问题,一次是带有正面背景的问题(确切的说是50/50分法). 关键是,BBQ的定型标签标记了目标群体而不是答案槽,所以定型答案在两个极点之间翻转. 一个天真(极性-盲)的比对率平均是:一个框架的比对率很高,另一个框架的比对率人为地低,即使对一个刻板印象很强的比对模式来说,通过建造也得出了50%的比对。 因此,我们报告极性认识-定型观念的一致:对于每一个有偏见的反应,我们在计算比对率之前,在问题的实际极性下找出定型答案。

blocks.en: Option-order invariance. Models show a mild letter preference (mean FaiR 0.667 when the neutral option is C vs. 0.609 on A and 0.616 on B, mean within-cell spread 0.113). Because BBQ places the unknown option near-uniformly across positions (A 32.6%, B 34.3%, C 33.1%), this preference cancels in aggregate. We confirm this directly for Qwen3-VL-8B by rotating the option→letter mapping: the resulting FaiR spread is only 0.007 on bbq_llm and 0.010 on melange (see Appendix for per-position results). No rotation averaging is applied to the reported numbers.
blocks.zh: 选择顺序无常. 模型显示出轻度的字母偏好(当中性选项是A上的C对0.609,B上的0.616,指细胞内扩散0.113). 由于BBQ将未知选项放在近乎统一的位置上(A 32.6%,B 34.3%,C 33.1%),这种偏好总共取消了. 我们直接为Qune3-VL-8B确认这一点,方法是旋转选项_字母映射:产生的FaiR传播率在bbq_llm上只有0.007,在melange上只有0.010(每个位置的结果见附录)。 报告的数字没有采用平均轮换率。

blocks.en: Interpreting FaiR: an important caveat. A high FaiR score may reflect genuine absence of social bias, a general tendency to abstain, or poor visual comprehension that makes the model default to “unknown.” We address this ambiguity with two complementary analyses: a perception control (Section 4.2 ) that directly tests whether models can identify the depicted attributes, and the stereotype-alignment breakdown in Section 5 .
blocks.zh: 解释FairR:一个重要的提醒. FaiR的得分高,可能反映真正没有社会偏见,普遍倾向于弃权,或者视觉理解不足,使得模型默认为“未知”. 我们用两个补充分析来解决这一含糊不清的问题:一种是感知控制(第4.2节),它直接检验模型是否能够识别所描绘的属性;另一种是第5节中的定型-调整分解。

blocks.en: Table 2 : FaiR scores for all 23 models across three evaluation settings, grouped by family and sorted by size within each family. The modality gap varies by family rather than by scale: every dense InternVL3.5 model incurs a large gap regardless of size, while Qwen2.5-VL is cleanly monotone with scale. “Recovery” measures how much neutral text compensates for the vision-induced fairness drop.
blocks.zh: 表2:所有23种模型的FaiR分数,分布于三个评价环境,按家庭分类,按每个家庭的大小排序. 模式差距因家庭不同而不同,而不是因尺度不同而不同:每个密集的InternVL3.5模型无论大小都会发生巨大差距,而Quen2.5-VL则与尺度一样是干净的单调. “恢复”衡量中性文本对视觉引起的公平下降的补偿程度。

blocks.en: 4.1 Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 结果

blocks.en: Table 2 presents FaiR scores for all 23 models under the three settings, sorted by the text→vision gap.
blocks.zh: 表2所列 FairR在三种设置下对全部23种模型的分数,按文本~视差排序.

blocks.en: The modality gap is the central finding. Every model is less fair in melange than in bbq_llm (mean gap − - 0.291, range − - 0.525 to − - 0.098). Text-only fairness saturates near 0.91–0.96 for models above ∼ {\sim} 27B, while vision-setting performance varies enormously. What differentiates models is how much of their text-side fairness survives the switch to pixels.

The gap is family-bound, not scale-bound. Scale effects are real within some families—Qwen2.5-VL is cleanly monotone (7B − - 0.252 → \rightarrow 32B − - 0.129 → \rightarrow 72B − - 0.098)—but they do not generalize. Every dense InternVL3.5 model sits at the bottom of the table regardless of size: the 38B variant incurs the largest gap measured ( − - 0.525) despite the second-best text-only score in its family. Sparsity is not uniformly penalised either: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B drops − - 0.287 while InternVL3.5-30B-A3B drops only − - 0.132 and is the best InternVL3.5 at any size.
blocks.zh: 差距是家庭的,而不是规模的。 缩放效应在有些家庭里是真实的 \ wen2.5-VL 是干净的单酮(7B − - 0 252 → 右侧32B − - 0.129 → 右侧 72B - - 0.098) - 但它们并没有概括. 每个稠密的InternVL3.5型号都坐落在表底,无论大小:38B型变体尽管在家族中只有文字分数第二,却出现所测量的最大差距(− - 0.525). 公平性也没有统一处罚: Qune3-VL-30B-A3B下降 − -0.287,而InternVL3.5-30B-A3B只下降 − -0.132,是任意大小最好的InternVL3.5.

blocks.en: Dense vs. MoE within the same release. The Qwen3.6 family provides a controlled comparison: same vendor, same release, two architectures. The dense 27B variant incurs a modest gap ( − - 0.137) and ranks sixth overall, while the MoE 35B-A3B variant—despite recording the best text-only FaiR of any model tested (0.956)—drops − - 0.414 and ranks among the worst. This three-fold gap difference, with vendor and release held constant, isolates architecture density as a variable: the MoE model’s sparse activation pattern may limit the capacity available for vision–language alignment during the modality switch.
blocks.zh: Dense和MOE在同一个释放。 Qwen3.6家族提供了受控的比较:同一卖家,同一发行,两个建筑. 密集的27B变体出现微小差距(−−−0.137),总体排名第六,而MOE 35B-A3B变体——尽管记录了任何测试型号(0.956)中最好的文本唯一FaiR——下降−−0.414,排在最差之列. 由于销售商和发行商持有不变的三重差距,将建筑密度隔离为变量:教育部模型的稀疏激活模式可能会限制模式切换时的视觉-语言匹配能力。

blocks.en: Context recovery is compensatory. Adding a neutral text description recovers an average of + + 0.047 FaiR points. The pattern is systematic: models that lose most to vision recover most from text (InternVL3.5-14B + + 0.157, InternVL3.5-1B + + 0.145, InternVL3.5-38B + + 0.141), while modality-robust models are flat or slightly negative. Text scaffolding patches a weak visual pathway rather than improving a strong one.
blocks.zh: 环境恢复是一种补偿。 添加中性文字描述可恢复平均++0.047 FaiR点. 模式是系统性的:最输于视觉的模型从文本中恢复得最多(InternVL3.5-14B + 0.157,InternVL3.5-1B + + 0.145,InternVL3.5-38B + + 0.141),而模式-robust模型是平的或略负的. 文本脚手架会修补一个弱的视觉通道,而不是改进一个强的通道。

blocks.en: Full per-category results for all 23 models are reported in Appendix C.
blocks.zh: 附录C报告所有23个模型的每个类别结果。

blocks.en: 4.2 Perception Control
blocks.zh: 4.2 认知控制

blocks.en: A high FaiR score in melange might simply reflect the model’s inability to perceive the depicted characters. To test this, we design a perception probe : for each scenario image, the model is asked which depicted person carries the manipulated demographic attribute (e.g., “Which person looks wealthier?”). Ground truth comes from BBQ’s group tags, giving 100% coverage of all 12,640 scenarios. The probe uses the same images, the same left/right answer format, and the same greedy decoding as the bias question, but is a forced two-way choice with no unknown option (chance = 0.5 =0.5 ). Each scenario is probed from both sides, so a model that always answers one side scores 0.5.
blocks.zh: 高分的FaiR可能只是反映模型无法感知被描绘的角色。 为了检验这一点,我们设计了一个感知探测器:对于每个情景图像,都问到被描绘的人的模型带有被操纵的人口属性(例如,“哪个人看起来更富有?” )。 地面真相来自BBQQ的团体标记,所有12,640场景都100%覆盖. 探针使用相同的图像,左/右答案格式,以及和偏差问题相同的贪婪解码,但是一种强制双向选择,没有未知选项(chance=0.5=0.5). 每个场景都从两侧探测,所以一个总是回答一方得分0.5的模型.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Perception probe accuracy vs. FaiR on melange , sorted by FaiR. Two probe types are reported: an attribute probe (“Which person looks wealthier?”) and a detection probe (“Is there a wealthy-looking person?”). Perception spans 90–95% while FaiR spans 82 points. Restricting FaiR to items the model provably perceives (“FaiR seen”) changes it by at most 0.012.
blocks.zh: 表3:感应探测器精度对 melange上的FaiR,由FaiR排序. 报告有两种探测器类型:属性探测器(“谁看起来更富有?” )和探测探测器(“有没有富人? ” 视线跨度为90-95%,而FaiR跨度为82分. 将FaiR限制在模型可明显感觉到的物品(“FaiR seen”)上,最多可更改0.012。

blocks.en: Table 3 shows the results for seven representative models under both probe types. Attribute-probe perception spans only 2.6 percentage points (0.905–0.931) and detection-probe perception spans 2.9 points (0.924–0.953), while FaiR spans 82 points (0.080–0.898). Restricting FaiR to items the model provably perceives changes it by at most 0.011, always slightly downward.
blocks.zh: 表3显示两种探测类型下七个代表性模型的结果。 属性-概率感知只跨2.6个百分点(0.905–0.931),检测-概率感知则跨2.9个百分点(0.924–0.953),而FaiR则跨82个百分点(0.080–0.898)。 将FairR限制在模型的项目上可以明显地感觉到它最多改变0.011,总是略微下降.

blocks.en: The decisive case is LLaVA-OneVision-7B: attribute perception 0.926 , detection perception 0.944 —statistically indistinguishable from the 72B Qwen—yet FaiR is 0.080 . The model identifies the two characters and their attributes almost perfectly but essentially never selects the neutral response. This demonstrates that the text→vision fairness gap is not a perception failure: models identify the manipulated attribute at 90–95% regardless of size or family, and conditioning on demonstrated perception leaves FaiR unchanged.
blocks.zh: 决定性案例是LLaVA-One Vision-7B:属性感知0.926,检测感知0.944——统计学上与72B Quen-yet FaiR是0.080. 该模型几乎完美地识别出两个字符及其属性,但本质上从未选择中性响应. 这表明,文本的公平性差距并不是感知失败:模型将被操纵的属性确定为90-95%,而不论大小或家庭大小,对所显示的感知的制约使得FairR保持不变。

blocks.en: Per-category perception accuracy, averaged over the seven models: gender 0.997, age 0.987, race 0.938, disability 0.907, appearance 0.894, socioeconomic status 0.862, and religion 0.848. The relatively high religion score (0.848) warrants disclosure: religious affiliation is not visually determinable in principle, yet models achieve well above chance, indicating that the image generator encoded visible religious markers (e.g., clothing or headwear). The religion scenarios therefore partly test response to visual cues the benchmark’s framing treats as absent. Per-category results are reported in the Appendix.
blocks.zh: 按类别划分的感知精度,在7种模型中平均为:性别0.997,年龄0.987,种族0.938,残疾0.907,外观0.894,社会经济地位0.862,宗教0.848. 相对较高的宗教分数(0.848)值得披露:宗教归属原则上无法在视觉上确定,但模型的实现远高于机会,表明图像生成器编码了可见的宗教标志(如衣物或头饰). 因此,宗教假设部分测试了对视觉反应的提示,认为基准框架不存在。 每个类别的结果在附录中报告。

blocks.en: 5 Ablations
blocks.zh: 5项

blocks.en: Figure 4 : FaiR scores as a function of model size within each family. Scale effects are visible within Qwen2.5-VL but do not generalise: InternVL3.5-38B incurs the largest modality gap measured despite the second-best text-only score in its family.
blocks.zh: 图4: FaiR的分数是每个家族内部模型大小的函数. 缩放效果在 Quen2.5- VL 中可见,但不概括 : InternVL3.5-38B在其家族中尽管获得仅次于文本的得分,但还是出现了最大的模式差距。

blocks.en: Scale effects are family-dependent, not universal. Within the Qwen2.5-VL family, larger models are consistently fairer: the text→vision gap shrinks monotonically from − - 0.345 (3B) to − - 0.098 (72B). However, this pattern does not generalise across families (Figure 4 ). InternVL3.5 shows no clear scale trend: the 38B variant incurs the largest gap of any model measured ( − - 0.525), while the sparse 30B-A3B variant incurs only − - 0.132 and is the best InternVL3.5 at any size. Among Qwen3-VL models, the 32B is far more robust than the 30B-A3B ( − - 0.121 vs. − - 0.287), indicating that architecture and training decisions dominate over raw parameter count. These results caution against blanket claims that scale reduces bias; the relationship is mediated by family-specific vision–language alignment.
blocks.zh: 规模效应依赖家庭,而不是普遍性。 在Quen2.5-VL家族中,较大的模型一直比较公平:文本-视差单调缩小,从0.345(3B)缩小到0.098(72B)。 然而,这种模式并没有在家庭中普遍出现(图4)。 InternVL3.5没有显示明显的尺度趋势:38B变体产生任何模型的最大差距(− - 0.525),而稀有的30B-A3B变体只产生− - 0.132,是任意大小最好的InternVL3.5. 在Quen3-VL模型中,32B型比30B-A3B型(−−−0.121 vs−−−0.287)强得多,表明架构和培训决定支配于原始参数计数. 这些结果提醒人们不要笼统地声称规模可以减少偏见;这种关系是通过针对特定家庭的愿景-语言的调整来实现的。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Per-category FaiR scores for representative models across bias categories. Within a family, category-level patterns are consistent across scales, suggesting that the bias profile is determined by the family’s visual encoder and alignment strategy rather than by model size alone.
blocks.zh: 图5:不同偏差类别代表性模型的每个类别FaiR分数。 在家庭内部,类别一级的模式在各种尺度上是一致的,这表明偏见的特征是由家庭的视觉编码和调整策略决定的,而不是仅由模型大小决定的。

blocks.en: Category-level bias patterns are consistent within families. Across all 23 models and seven bias categories (Figure 5 ; full results in Appendix C), race and religion consistently show the highest FaiR scores, while age and appearance tend to show the lowest. This ordering is stable within each model family across scales, indicating that the bias profile reflects the family’s visual encoder and alignment procedure. Full per-category results are in Appendix C.
blocks.zh: 类别层次的偏见模式在家庭内部是一致的。 在所有23个模型和7个偏差类别(图5;附录C的全部结果)中,种族和宗教始终显示FaiR分数最高,而年龄和外观往往显示最低。 这种定购在跨尺度的每个模组家族中是稳定的,表明偏差特征反映了家族的视觉编码和对齐程序. 每个类别的全部结果载于附录C。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Polarity-blind stereotype alignment rates. These rates hover near 50%, but this is an artifact of ignoring question polarity (see text). Polarity-aware alignment is 62–99% across all 23 models.
blocks.zh: 图6:极视-盲定型比对率。 这些率徘徊在50%左右,但这是忽略问题极性的一件文物(见文本). 在所有23种模型中,极性-意识对齐率为62-99%。

blocks.en: When MLLMs commit to a biased answer, it overwhelmingly aligns with human stereotypes. The polarity-blind stereotype-alignment rate (Figure 6 ) averages 0.496 across all 69 model–setting cells, suggesting at first glance that biased outputs are randomly distributed relative to human stereotypes. However, this figure is an artifact of the metric: because each context appears with both a negatively and a positively framed question, and the stereotypical answer flips between them (Section 4 ), a polarity-blind rate yields ∼ {\sim} 0.50 by construction for any stereotype-aligned model.
blocks.zh: 当MLLMs承诺作出有偏见的回答时,它绝大多数都赞同人类的定型观念。 极性-盲定型-对齐率(图6)在所有69个模型-设定细胞中平均为0.496, 乍一看表明偏差输出相对于人类定型的随机分布. 然而,这个数字是衡量尺度的产物:因为每个上下文都出现一个负面和正面的问题,而陈规定型的答案则在两者之间翻转(第4节),极性盲率的得分率是... ? 0.50通过构建 任何刻板印象模式。

blocks.en: Correcting for polarity reveals the true picture. Across all 23 models and three settings, polarity-aware stereotype alignment averages 0.770 (range 0.591–0.985). On negatively framed questions the rate reaches 0.90 on average, while on positively framed questions it is 0.74. Alignment is consistently higher in bbq_llm (mean 0.853) than in melange (mean 0.725) or melange_with_context (mean 0.733), indicating that the visual pathway introduces noise but does not reverse the stereotypical tendency. These results demonstrate that when MLLMs commit to a non-neutral answer, they overwhelmingly reproduce human social stereotypes rather than exhibiting novel bias patterns.
blocks.zh: 纠正极性揭示了真实情况。 在所有23种模型和3种设置中,极性-认知定型对齐平均为0.770(介于0.591-0.985之间)。 在负面问题上,平均比率为0.90,而在正面问题上,平均比率为0.74。 bbq_llm(平均0.853)的对齐率一直高于melange(平均0.725)或melange_with_context(平均0.733),表明视觉路径引入了噪音,但没有扭转定型倾向。 这些结果表明,当MLLMs致力于非中立的答案时,它们绝大多数会复制人类的社会定型观念,而不是表现出新的偏见模式。

blocks.en: This analysis covers six of the seven demographic categories for which stereotype annotations are available (age, gender, appearance, disability, religion, and race). The socioeconomic status (SES) category is excluded because group membership cannot be reliably inferred from appearance alone, so no stereotype labels were annotated for SES. Among the covered categories, gender has near-complete annotation (96% of scenarios) while race has partial coverage (27%), because stereotype labels were assigned only when the relevant group attributes are visually apparent.
blocks.zh: 这一分析涵盖有定型观念说明的七个人口类别中的六个(年龄、性别、外貌、残疾、宗教和种族)。 社会经济地位(SES)类别被排除在外,因为仅从外表上无法可靠地推断群体成员身份,因此没有给SES附加任何定型观念标签。 在所涉类别中,性别有近乎完整的注释(占情景的96%),而种族有部分报道(27%),因为只有在相关群体属性明显可见时才给定型标签。

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Bias benchmarks for language models. The Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ) ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) , included in BIG-bench ( Srivastava et al., 2022 ) , assesses the extent to which LLMs rely on social stereotypes when responding to situations that lack sufficient contextual information. BBQ serves as the primary foundation for Melange, which preserves the benchmark’s ambiguous scenario formulation and coverage of seven bias categories while adapting its evaluation framework to visual inputs. Among the earlier approaches developed exclusively for textual evaluation, UNQOVER ( Li et al., 2020 ) examines stereotypical tendencies through questions with insufficient contextual detail, whereas StereoSet ( Nadeem et al., 2021 ) investigates the stereotypical associations learned by pretrained language models. A broader perspective is presented by Gallegos et al. (2024) , who systematically review research on bias and fairness in LLMs, encompassing existing evaluation benchmarks, measurement techniques, and bias mitigation methods. Nevertheless, these approaches operate entirely within the textual modality and therefore cannot establish whether model behaviour changes when socially relevant information is communicated through images instead of language.
blocks.zh: 语言模型的偏见基准。 列入BIG-bench(Srivastava等人,2022年)的Bias问答基准(Parrish等人,2022年)评估了有限责任公司在应对缺乏充分背景资料的情况时依赖社会定型观念的程度。 BBQ是Melange的主要基础,它保留了基准的模棱两可的情景表述和七个偏差类别的覆盖面,同时使其评价框架适应视觉投入。 在早先专门为文字评价制定的办法中,联合国土地覆盖物资料数据库(Li等人,2020年)通过背景细节不足的问题来审查陈规定型倾向,而StreoSet(Nadeem等人,2021年)则调查通过预先培训的语言模型所学到的陈规定型社团。 Gallegos等人(2024年)提出了更广泛的观点,他系统地审查了关于有限责任公司中的偏见和公平性的研究,包括现有的评价基准、衡量技术和减少偏见的方法。 然而,这些方法完全在文字模式内运作,因此,当社会相关信息通过图像而不是语言传播时,无法确定模式行为是否发生变化。

blocks.en: Bias in vision and text-to-image generation. Research on visual generative systems has also revealed substantial demographic biases. Bianchi et al. (2023) show that text-to-image generation systems reinforce demographic stereotypes across large-scale outputs, while Cheong et al. (2024) identify biases associated with gender and race in images produced by DALL-E Mini. Considering the role of data preparation, Paullada et al. (2021) examine how decisions made during dataset construction can introduce and preserve social biases, whereas hanna2019towards advocate incorporating critical-race methodologies into research on algorithmic fairness. However, the emphasis of these studies lies primarily on the content of generated imagery or the characteristics of underlying datasets, rather than on decisions made by multimodal models. Consequently, they explain the representations produced by image generators without investigating how a downstream MLLM interprets and responds to visually presented social situations that remain ambiguous.
blocks.zh: 在视觉和文字到图像生成中存在偏见. 对视觉基因系统的研究也揭示了重大的人口偏见。 Bianchi等人(2023年)表明,文字到图像生成系统在大规模产出中强化了人口陈规定型观念,而Cheong等人则认为,文字到图像生成系统强化了人口陈规定型观念。 (2024) 查明DALL-E Mini制作的图像中与性别和种族有关的偏见。 考虑到数据编制的作用,Paullada等人(2021年)研究了数据集构建过程中做出的决定如何引入和保持社会偏见,而Hanna2019至19则主张将关键种族方法纳入算法公平性研究。 然而,这些研究的重点主要是生成图像的内容或基本数据集的特征,而不是由多式联运模式作出的决定。 因此,他们解释了图像生成者所作的表述,而没有调查下游的MLLM如何解释和应对视觉呈现的仍然模糊不清的社会状况。

blocks.en: Evaluating bias in multimodal models. Existing efforts to assess social bias in MLLMs have introduced several evaluation benchmarks, although their coverage remains relatively constrained. Ruggeri and Nozza (2023) investigate correlations related to gender by analysing the next-token probabilities assigned by MLLMs when answering questions designed to expose biased associations. Using artificially constructed counterfactual images, xiao2024genderbias and howard2024uncovering examine biases concerning gender and occupations. Similarly, Sathe et al. (2024) and Fraser and Kiritchenko (2024) assess gender- and race-related biases in occupational contexts. The work of wu2024evaluating instead concentrates on identifying demographic characteristics within natural images, addressing a different objective from our investigation of harmful stereotypical associations. The approaches most directly comparable to Melange are those proposed by Narnaware et al. (2025) and wang2024vlbiasbench , both of which transfer BBQ scenarios into the visual modality. However, their evaluation designs do not guarantee that paired individuals are identical in demographic characteristics other than the attribute being examined. Furthermore, their use of written character names introduces a possible interaction between visually conveyed information and linguistic bias. Melange addresses these limitations by identifying individuals exclusively through spatial references and ensuring that paired characters are aligned across every demographic characteristic except the intended target attribute.
blocks.zh: 评估多式联运模式中的偏差。 目前评估小额供资和微型企业中社会偏见的工作已经引入了若干评价基准,尽管其覆盖面仍然相对有限。 Ruggeri和Nozza(2023年)通过分析MLLM在回答旨在揭露有偏见的社团的问题时所分配的近亲概率来调查与性别有关的关联性. 利用人工制造的反事实图像,Xiao2024性别偏见和Howard2024未涵盖性别和职业方面的偏见。 同样, Sathe等人(2024年)和Fraser和Kiritchenko(2024年)评估职业环境中与性别和种族有关的偏见。 相反,2024年评估工作的重点是查明自然图像中的人口特征,处理与我们对有害的陈规定型联系的调查不同的目标。 与Melange最直接可比的方法是Narnaware等人(2025年)和wang2024vlbiasbench 提出的方法,两者都将BBQ假想转移到视觉模式中. 然而,其评价设计不能保证配对个体在人口特征上与正在审查的属性不同。 此外,他们使用书面字符名称,在视觉传递的信息与语言偏差之间产生了可能的相互作用。 Melange通过完全通过空间参考识别个人,确保除预定目标属性外,每个人口特征的配对字符一致,来应对这些局限性。

blocks.en: Synthetic and counterfactual evaluation data. The use of controlled image synthesis to construct evaluation datasets has become increasingly established. For instance, yeganeh2025latent employ latent drifting within diffusion models to generate counterfactual medical images, while Chang et al. (2024) review methodologies for evaluating large language models, including approaches based on synthetic datasets. Despite these developments, none of the aforementioned studies construct corresponding text-only and vision-only versions of the same socially ambiguous situations. This paired evaluation structure constitutes the central contribution of Melange, comprising 12,640 scenarios derived from BBQ and assessed under both bbq_llm and melange conditions. In addition, a perception control is incorporated to demonstrate that the observed performance difference between modalities cannot be attributed to limitations in visual competence.
blocks.zh: 合成与反事实评价数据. 利用受控图像合成构建评价数据集的做法日益确立。 例如,yeganeh2025latent在扩散模型中采用潜在的漂移来生成反事实医学图像,而Chang等人则采用这种方式。 (2024)审查评价大型语言模型的方法,包括基于合成数据集的方法. 尽管取得了这些进展,但上述研究均未对同样的社会模棱两可的情况形成相应的文本和仅具有远见的版本。 这种配对评价结构是梅朗格的核心贡献,包括12,640个从BBQ衍生出来的假设,并在bbq_llm和melange条件下进行评估。 此外,还纳入了感知控制,以表明所观察到的模式之间的性能差异不能归因于视觉能力的限制。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: Our study has several limitations that should be considered when interpreting the results.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有一些局限性,在解释研究结果时应予考虑。

blocks.en: First, all 12,640 scenarios the benchmark contains no disambiguated items. Melange therefore measures abstention under ambiguity and cannot detect bias in cases where a correct answer exists. Extending to disambiguated contexts would test whether models apply stereotypes even when sufficient information is available to answer correctly.
blocks.zh: 首先,基准中所有12 640种情况都包含没有含糊不清的项目。 因此,Melange在含糊不清的情况下采取了弃权措施,在存在正确答案的情况下无法发现偏见。 扩大至相互矛盾的情况将检验模型是否采用陈规定型观念,即使有足够的信息可以正确回答。

blocks.en: Second, stereotype annotations are deliberately absent where group membership is not reliably inferable from appearance. SES has 0% coverage, race 27%, and gender 96%; the remaining four categories (age, appearance, disability, religion) have 100% coverage. The stereotype-alignment analysis in Section 5 therefore covers six categories and excludes SES entirely.
blocks.zh: 第二,如果集团成员不可靠地从外表上推断出来,则故意不作定型观念说明。 特殊教育的覆盖率为0%,种族为27%,性别为96%;其余四类(年龄、外貌、残疾、宗教)的覆盖率为100%。 因此,第5节中的定型调整分析包括六个类别,完全不包括特别服务协定。

blocks.en: Third, all images are synthetic, generated by Flux ( flux ) . The perception probe reveals that the generator encodes visible religious markers (models score 0.848 on religion despite religious affiliation being visually indeterminate in principle), meaning the religion scenarios partly test response to visual cues the benchmark’s framing treats as absent. More broadly, synthetic images may introduce distributional differences from natural photographs that affect model behaviour in ways our evaluation cannot isolate.
blocks.zh: 第三,所有图像都是合成的,由Flux(通量)生成. 感知探究显示,生成者编码了可见的宗教标记(模型在宗教上得分为0.848,尽管宗教归属原则上在视觉上不确定),这意味着宗教情景部分测试了对视觉的反应暗示基准框架视而不见。 更广泛地说,合成图像可能会引入与自然照片的分布差异,这些差异会影响模型行为,而我们的评价无法孤立。

blocks.en: Fourth, the original experimental design included four evaluation settings; two of these (side-by-side character crops without a scene background) are not reproducible from the public release because the per-character renders are no longer available. All results in this paper use the three reproducible settings: bbq_llm , melange , and melange_with_context .
blocks.zh: 第四,最初的实验设计包括四个评价设置;其中两个(无场景背景的侧面角色作物)由于每个角色制作的版本不再可用,因此无法从公开发行中复制. 本文中的所有结果都使用三种可复制的设置:bbq_llm,melange,和melange_ with_context 。

blocks.en: Finally, our methodology does not explicitly control for latent visual confounds in generated images, such as facial expressions or clothing colour. Prior work has shown that MLLMs associate bright clothing with positive attributes; if the diffusion model systematically renders one demographic group with different expressions or attire, this could introduce a bias pathway orthogonal to the intended variable of analysis. Controlling for these factors is an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的方法没有明确控制生成的图像中的潜在视觉混乱,例如面部表情或服装颜色。 先前的研究表明,MLLMs将亮衣服与正属性联系起来;如果扩散模型系统化地使一个具有不同表达或着装的人口群体,这可能会给预期的分析变量引入偏差路径。 控制这些因素是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Melange, a vision-language bias benchmark containing 126,400 images spanning 12,640 scenarios across seven demographic categories. By evaluating the same BBQ-derived scenarios in matched text-only and vision-only settings, we isolate the fairness effect of the input modality. Across 23 open-source MLLMs, switching from text to vision reduces fairness by 0.291 on average—a gap that varies by model family rather than by scale alone. A perception control confirms that this gap is not an artifact of visual comprehension: models identify the depicted demographic attributes at 90–95% accuracy yet still fail to abstain. When models do commit to a biased answer, polarity-aware stereotype alignment shows they choose the human-stereotypical response roughly three-quarters of the time. Melange, its evaluation code, and all generated images are publicly available to support continued research on mitigating bias in multimodal AI systems.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Melange,这是一个视觉语言偏差基准,包含126 400幅图片,涵盖7个人口类别中的12 640幅情景。 通过在匹配的仅文本和仅视觉设置中评价相同的BBQ派生情景,我们孤立了输入模式的公平效果. 在23个开放源代码的MLLMs中,从文本到视觉的转换平均降低了0.291的公平性,这一差距因家庭模式而异,而不只是规模。 一个感知控制证实,这一差距不是视觉理解的产物:模型将描绘的人口属性确定为90-95%的准确度,但仍然未能弃权。 当模型确实致力于一个偏颇的答案时,极性-认知的定型比对显示他们选择了人类-定型反应大约四分之三的时间. Melange、其评价代码和所有生成的图像均可公开查阅,以支持继续研究减轻多式联运AI系统中的偏见。
